# BrowserView: a web page in your layout

<!-- Generated by dist/sdk/gen-widget-docs.py from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

The embedded browser component and its port.

## `browser`  (`crates/iyakki-ui-sdk/src/browser.rs`)

`BrowserView`: the IYAKKI Browser as a component an SDK app places in its layout, like a web view widget (F-SDK-60, UI-SDK.md
"Embedding the browser"). The app gives it a rectangle and an address (or page content); the view shows the page, takes the wheel, keys
and link taps, and reports the title, the address and the loading state as events.

The view does no network and no drawing of pages itself (the core rule). It is handed a [`BrowserPort`], which is the core's: the core
judges every address (known-bad sites, the person's policy), loads the page, and answers with a *display list* that this view replays
inside its rectangle, so the shell, a client and a WASM tile show the same page. A download or a permission question the page raises
comes back as a prompt the person answers (a bar under the page), never the page itself.

### const `ACTION_SPAN`

The room of action numbers a view uses from its base: page links first, the view's own buttons from [`OWN_ACTIONS`].

```rust
pub const ACTION_SPAN: u32 = 10_000
```

### trait `BrowserPort`

What the view asks of the core. Errors are plain sentences the view may show. The shell's implementation is over the core's browser
sessions (`iyakki-apps`, `sdk_browser.rs`); [`MemBrowser`] is the in-memory one for tests and the browser preview.

```rust
pub trait BrowserPort
```

Methods:

- `fn open(&mut self, spec: &ViewSpec) -> Result<u64, String>`
- `fn close(&mut self, id: u64)`
- `fn navigate(&mut self, id: u64, nav: &Nav) -> Result<(), String>`
- `fn input(&mut self, id: u64, input: &PageInput) -> Result<(), String>`
- `fn find(&mut self, id: u64, query: &str, forward: bool) -> Result<FindInfo, String>`
- `fn state(&mut self, id: u64) -> Result<PageInfo, String>`
- `fn frame(&mut self, id: u64, since: u64) -> Result<Option<(u64, String)>, String>`: The frame (display list text) when its generation is not `since`.
- `fn prompts(&mut self, id: u64) -> Vec<PagePrompt>`
- `fn answer(&mut self, id: u64, prompt: u64, allow: bool) -> Result<(), String>`

### enum `BrowserEvent`

What the app hears from the view (take them with [`BrowserView::take_events`]).

```rust
pub enum BrowserEvent
```

Variants:

- `Opened`
- `Title(String)`
- `Url(String)`: The address changed (a link, a redirect, back or forward).
- `Loading(bool)`
- `Failed(Option<String>)`: A load or an address was refused or failed (the plain reason); `None` when it is cleared by the next good load.
- `Find(FindInfo)`
- `Prompt(PagePrompt)`: A download or permission question is waiting for the person.
- `Closed(String)`: The core ended the session or would not open one.

### struct `BrowserView`

```rust
pub struct BrowserView
```

Methods:

- `pub fn new(port: Box<dyn BrowserPort>, base: u32) -> BrowserView`: A view over the core's port. `base` is the first of [`ACTION_SPAN`] action numbers the view may use in the app's layout.
- `pub fn with_engine(mut self, e: Engine) -> BrowserView`: The engine to ask for (before the first draw; later it applies at the next open).
- `pub fn with_family(mut self, f: PageFamily) -> BrowserView`: The page's default font family (sans or mono).
- `pub fn with_size_policy(mut self, p: SizePolicy) -> BrowserView`
- `pub fn set_size_policy(&mut self, p: SizePolicy)`
- `pub fn set_focused(&mut self, on: bool)`: Whether the wheel and the keys go to the page. The app sets it from its own focus; a tap on a link of the page sets it too.
- `pub fn is_focused(&self) -> bool`
- `pub fn owns_action(&self, a: u32) -> bool`
- `pub fn load_url(&mut self, url: &str)`: Open this address (the core judges it; a refusal comes as `Failed`). A bare host name is fine.
- `pub fn load_html(&mut self, base: &str, html: &str)`: Show content the app brings (a help text, a mail body): never fetched, shown under `base` as its address.
- `pub fn back(&mut self)`
- `pub fn forward(&mut self)`
- `pub fn reload(&mut self)`
- `pub fn stop(&mut self)`
- `pub fn url(&self) -> &str`
- `pub fn title(&self) -> &str`
- `pub fn is_loading(&self) -> bool`
- `pub fn can_back(&self) -> bool`
- `pub fn can_forward(&self) -> bool`
- `pub fn error(&self) -> Option<&str>`
- `pub fn engine_used(&self) -> Option<Engine>`: The engine that really draws the page (known once the session is open).
- `pub fn find_state(&self) -> FindInfo`
- `pub fn find(&mut self, query: &str, forward: bool) -> FindInfo`: Find in page: a new query goes to the first match, the same query again to the next or previous one; empty clears the marks.
- `pub fn prompts(&self) -> &[PagePrompt]`
- `pub fn answer(&mut self, allow: bool)`: Answer the oldest question (what the bar's Allow and Deny buttons do; a chat approval can answer through the core too).
- `pub fn take_events(&mut self) -> Vec<BrowserEvent>`
- `pub fn close(&mut self)`: End the session (the view opens a new one at the next draw unless it is dropped).
- `pub fn event(&mut self, ev: &UiEvent) -> bool`: Feed one event; true when the view used it (the app then does not).
- `pub fn refresh(&mut self)`: Ask the core for the state and a new frame, and say what changed.
- `pub fn draw(&mut self, c: &mut dyn Canvas, cx: &UiCx, area: Rect) -> Rect`: Draw the view inside `area` and return the rectangle it took (by its size policy). The page is the core's frame replayed here; the bar for a waiting question is drawn under it; when the core would not open a session the view says why, with a Retry button.

### struct `MemBrowser`

An in-memory [`BrowserPort`] for tests and the browser preview: scripted pages, one session at a time per `open`, links that work. It
has no known-bad list and no policy (the core's job); it is not a substitute for the core in a test of those.

```rust
pub struct MemBrowser
```

Public fields:

- `pub pages: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, MemPage>`
- `pub log: Vec<String>`

Methods:

- `pub fn with_page(mut self, url: &str, title: &str, lines: &[&str], links: &[(&str, &str)]) -> MemBrowser`
